title: I have a favor to ask you
expression: Don't hang up. I have a favor to ask you

sentences.en: Don't hang up. I have a favor to ask you.
You have a favor to ask of me?
Yeah. The thing is, I have all these clothes from Paris,
sentences.ko: 응. 실은 파리에서 받은 옷이 잔뜩 있는데,

sentences.en: and I don't have anyplace to wear them,
so I was wondering if you could take them off my hands.
sentences.ko: 네가 좀 맡아줄 수 있을까 해서.

sentences.en: Well, I don't know. It's a huge imposition.
And I'll have to get them taken in. I mean, they'll drown me.
sentences.ko: 수선도 해야 할 거고. 나한텐 헐렁할 테니까.

sentences.en: But I suppose I could help you out.
I will have Roy pick them up this afternoon.
Thanks, Em. I appreciate it. Good luck.
